??? quote "Dialogue"

    - Ah. An audience. Lavinia, Mistress of the Gilded Stage. You may admire me, *Player*, and then you may buy a ticket.
        - *Choice:* Tell me about yourself.
        - *Choice:* Tell me about the Gilded Stage.
        - *Choice:* What is the new play?
        - *Choice:* How is the play?
        - *Choice:* Goodbye.
    - I walked through that stage door at fifteen and asked for anything at all. I swept the boards for a season. Then an actress fell ill, I went on in her place, and I never came off again.
    - Thirty-five years of every great part in this house. The old manager left it to me. I have been married to it ever since, and it has been far more expensive than any husband.
    - Gilt, crimson, a cheap gallery under the roof and a box for the palace that no one from the palace has sat in for years. One night the queen will sit there. Mark me.
    - [Crispin](../npcs/crispin.md)'s Balrog War. All of it, the largest thing the Row has ever attempted. I have bet the theatre's savings, a loan on the building and my own name on it.
    - He has four acts and no fifth, my two leads will not share a stage, and the audiences go home earlier every month. One last triumph, *Player*. That is all I ask of the world.
    - Exit stage left, darling. Always leave them wanting more.
    - The fourth act has its wonder, darling. Amber in the lamplight. Now if only Crispin would give me a fifth.
